title: MD5 use via hashlib.md5 (python) — review required
description: The python call hashlib.md5 computes MD5, which is broken for security purposes (collisions are practical). It is unacceptable for passwords, signatures, or integrity of untrusted data, but still fine for non-security checksums. This lexical rule cannot tell the use case — treat every hit as review-required.
remediation: Use hashlib.sha256 for any security purpose. Keep MD5 only for non-security checksums with a comment saying so.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches any hashlib.md5 call regardless of purpose. Bare md5() calls belong to the generic rule; other weak algorithms are separate rules.
